verdict.rationale: Phoenix's self-hosting docs explicitly state data stays entirely within your infrastructure and can be fully air-gapped, giving users full control over where data resides (docs-27/56/37/67 show deployment options across Docker, K8s, cloud providers, letting users pick their own region/infra). However there's no explicit 'region selection' feature for a managed/cloud offering — residency is achieved only via self-hosting choice, not a built-in region picker. Missing for 10: explicit multi-region cloud/managed hosting options with a region-selection control, and any compliance/residency certification documentation.
